item.media:description: The lawsuit against Emmitt Smith, a three-time Super Bowl champion with the Cowboys, seeks the return of the $2.5 million loan plus interest.

item.title: Vikings sign veteran Kyle Van Noy to add depth at edge rusher
item.description: The 35-year-old veteran is expected to back up Andrew Van Ginkel and Dallas Turner and will be aiming to improve on his 57 career sacks.
item.media:description: Veteran edge rusher Kyle Van Noy will hope to improve on his 57 career sacks this fall with the Vikings.

item.title: Colts GM on NFL players going back to college: 'That's the stupidest (thing) I've ever heard'
item.description: "Your entire life, you fight to get up to the NFL. OK, but now we’re gonna go back? That makes a lot of freakin’ sense," Chris Ballard said.
item.media:description: Colts general manager Chris Ballard was asked about NFL players returning to play in college.

item.title: Tony Romo pleads no contest to OWI charge, acknowledges ‘over-reliance on alcohol’
item.description: The CBS NFL analyst, currently on leave from the network, said “I am working closely with a team of doctors to address my health.”
item.media:description: Tony Romo was placed on leave by CBS following his arrest in Wisconsin in July.

item.title: GM Brian Gutekunst expects Josh Jacobs to play for Packers this season
item.description: The NFL has yet to issue a suspension for Jacobs, who can't practice or play while on the commissioner's exempt list.
item.media:description: Josh Jacobs is currently on the commissioner exempt list.
